head: Perplexity Multiagent: up to 16 AI agents work on one task
dek: Perplexity added Multiagent on 17 November, a new effort level in Perplexity Computer above Ultra, where a lead agent splits a task among up to 16 agents on different AI models that share findings and check each other's work. It's for Perplexity Max subscribers on the web.
details: Claude Fable 5.2 leads and plans the task; the default team is Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Carbon, and you can name other models in your request. You can see which agents and models are running, and stopping the thread stops the whole team. Perplexity suggests it for long jobs such as checking an annual report, comparing financial scenarios or organizing records for a tax professional.
where: Perplexity Max subscribers, on the web, from 17 November
means: If you pay for Perplexity Max, you can give a big research or document job to several AI models at once instead of one. Pro and free users don't get it.
todo: In Perplexity Computer on the web, pick Multiagent on the effort slider before you start a new task.
